name: Vector space
description: Set closed under addition and scalar multiplication satisfying associativity, commutativity, identity, inverses, and distributivity. Foundation for all substrate representations.

name: Inner product
description: Bilinear form on vector space producing scalar. Conjugate-symmetric, positive-definite. Defines similarity, length, and angle.

name: Cosine similarity
description: Normalized inner product. Measures angular alignment between vectors independently of magnitude. Range [-1, 1].

name: Complex field
description: Field of complex numbers C with addition, multiplication, division. Closed under operations; algebraically closed. Underlies FHRR.

name: Real field
description: Field of real numbers R. Ordered, complete, archimedean. Underlies HRR.

name: Unit modulus constraint
description: Restriction of complex (or real) elements to magnitude = 1. Yields the unit circle in C; phasor representation. Preserves binding-unbinding inverses exactly in FHRR.

name: Probability distribution
description: Non-negative function summing/integrating to 1 over its support. Foundation for inference, weak labels, and confidence.

name: Shannon entropy
description: Expected information content of a distribution. H(p) = -sum p_i log p_i. Measures uncertainty; lower bound on coding length.

name: KL divergence
description: Asymmetric measure of divergence between two distributions. D_KL(p||q) = sum p_i log(p_i/q_i). Non-negative; zero iff p=q.

name: Group axioms
description: Closure, associativity, identity element, inverses. Foundation for binding operations and reversible compositions.

name: Ring axioms
description: Abelian group under addition plus associative multiplication plus distributivity. Underlies polynomial and matrix algebras.

name: Field axioms
description: Ring where every nonzero element has multiplicative inverse. R, C, Q. Foundation for vector spaces.

name: Discrete optimization
description: Optimization over discrete/combinatorial spaces. Often NP-hard in general; certain structured cases polynomial (assignment, MST, shortest-path).

name: Graph topology
description: Vertices + edges + adjacency structure. Directed, undirected, weighted, bipartite variants. Foundation for routing, retrieval, and analogy.

name: FHRR binding
description: Element-wise complex multiplication of two unit-modulus phasor vectors. Binding operation in Fourier Holographic Reduced Representation. Inverse is FHRR unbinding.

name: FHRR unbinding
description: Element-wise multiplication by complex conjugate. Inverse of FHRR binding; recovers one operand given binding output and other operand.

name: Cleanup
description: Project a noisy substrate vector onto the nearest atom in a codebook. Implements associative memory recall. Implemented via cosine or Hamming nearest-neighbor.

metadata.complexity: O(N*K) where K is codebook size

name: Tier-2 schema (count-weighted superposition)
description: Substrate Tier-2 storage as count-weighted superposition of constituent atoms. Carries count statistics (generative) or learned weights (discriminative). Foundation for count-NB and discriminative-perceptron substrate variants.

name: Context binding
description: Bind context vector with payload to disambiguate polysemic or context-dependent retrieval.

name: Role-filler binding
description: Bind role vectors to filler vectors to encode structured relations. Core of relational substrate representation.

name: Hamming distance
description: Number of differing positions between bipolar vectors. Discrete similarity measure for bipolar substrates.

name: Cosine cleanup
description: Cleanup using cosine similarity to rank codebook atoms.

name: Circular convolution (HRR binding)
description: Binding operation in Holographic Reduced Representation. FHRR (frequency-domain) is the FFT dual.

name: Viterbi decoding
description: Dynamic-programming algorithm for max-probability state sequence given observations. Globally optimal over linear chains.

name: Forward algorithm
description: DP for marginal observation likelihood under HMM. Sum over all state sequences.

name: Backward algorithm
description: DP for backward HMM probabilities. Used in EM and posterior decoding.

name: Count-based Naive Bayes
description: Naive Bayes classifier with count-statistic priors stored as Tier-2 schemas. Validated substrate-only on intent (0.834) and slot-filling.

name: Averaged discriminative perceptron
description: Linear classifier with learned weights via mistake-driven update + averaging. Validated substrate-only on MAWPS 0.806, MultiArith 0.753 (2-op), CODE algorithm-pattern 0.750.

name: Hungarian algorithm
description: Polynomial-time optimal bipartite-matching algorithm minimizing total cost. Globally optimal over assignment polytope.

name: Jonker-Volgenant algorithm
description: More efficient bipartite-matching solver, particularly for sparse cost matrices.

name: Chu-Liu-Edmonds algorithm
description: Directed minimum spanning tree (arborescence) algorithm. Globally optimal tree-structured decoding.

name: Prim's MST algorithm
description: Greedy minimum spanning tree algorithm for undirected weighted graphs.

name: Dijkstra's algorithm
description: Single-source shortest-path algorithm for non-negative-weight graphs.

name: A* search
description: Heuristic-guided shortest-path search. Optimal with admissible heuristic.

name: Beam search
description: K-best approximate search keeping top-K candidates at each step. Trades optimality for tractability.

name: Dynamic programming
description: Optimal substructure + overlapping subproblems via memoization. Foundation for Viterbi, MST, edit-distance, etc.

name: PCA whitening
description: Decorrelate features via PCA followed by variance normalization. Preserves variance structure aligned with principal axes.

name: ZCA whitening
description: Zero-phase whitening; preserves orientation of original axes. Rotation-equivalent to PCA whitening.

name: Bayesian inference
description: Posterior = likelihood * prior / evidence. General framework for substrate-stored posterior updates.

name: MAP estimation
description: Maximum a posteriori; the mode of the posterior. Used in classification and inference.

name: Expectation-maximization
description: Iterative algorithm for parameter estimation with latent variables. E-step computes posteriors; M-step maximizes parameters.

name: Answer-consistency weak labels
description: Weak-supervision method: for each training example, find latent assignment that makes the schema constraint yield the gold answer. Used in substrate MATH solver to train without role annotations.

name: Cross-entropy loss
description: Loss function for probabilistic classification. -log P(true_class).

name: Perceptron weight update
description: Mistake-driven weight update: w += y*x on mistake. Foundation of perceptron and structured-perceptron learning.

name: Probabilistic inference (family)
description: Methods for computing posteriors, marginals, or modes of probability distributions. Bayesian inference, EM, HMM forward-backward, MAP all instantiate this family.

name: Discriminative classification (family)
description: Methods learning weights to discriminate classes from input features. Perceptron, count-NB, structured perceptron instantiate this family.

name: Representation transform (family)
description: Linear or nonlinear transforms that change vector representation while preserving information. PCA, ZCA, embedding mappings instantiate this family.

name: Graph traversal (family)
description: Algorithms exploring graph structure: shortest-path, heuristic search, BFS/DFS. Dijkstra, A*, beam search instantiate this family.

name: Sequence decoding (family)
description: DP-based optimal-sequence decoders for chain-structured outputs. Viterbi, forward, backward instantiate this family.

name: Weak supervision (family)
description: Methods training models without gold-standard labels using surrogate signals (answer-consistency, distant-supervision, noisy labels).

name: Algebraic binding (family)
description: Substrate operations that compose two vectors into a structured combination with inverse. FHRR binding, HRR circular convolution, role-filler binding instantiate this family.

name: Cleanup retrieval (family)
description: Methods projecting noisy substrate vectors onto codebook atoms via nearest-neighbor in some metric.

name: Superposition aggregation (family)
description: Methods combining multiple substrate items via vector sum (+normalize). Bundling, superposition, Tier-2 weighted bundles.

name: Convex optimization
description: CONTINUOUS optimization over convex objective and convex constraints. Polynomial-time solvable; global optimum guaranteed. Distinguished from discrete optimization: the search domain is a continuous convex set (smooth) and the objective is convex differentiable.

name: Global discrete optimization (family)
description: DISCRETE combinatorial optimization algorithms providing global optimum over discrete combinatorial spaces in polynomial time via problem structure. Distinguished from convex optimization: search domain is discrete/combinatorial, not continuous. Hungarian assignment + MST + Viterbi + Chu-Liu-Edmonds all instantiate this family.

name: Collins structured perceptron
description: Discriminative max-margin classifier with structured-output decoding (assignment-constraint enforcement). Learns weights via mistake-driven structured-perceptron update over joint feature representation. NOT probabilistic; max-margin formulation in structured output space.

name: HMM transition probability
description: Probabilistic generative model component: probability of next state given current state P(state_{t+1} | state_t). Captures sequential structure in generative HMM framework. Used in Viterbi (max) and forward-backward (sum).

name: HMM emission probability
description: Probabilistic generative model component: probability of observation given hidden state P(observation | state). Computed via count statistics (substrate-classical) or substrate Tier-2 schema. Used in Viterbi (max) and forward-backward (sum).

name: Superposition
description: Vector SUM ONLY without normalization. Raw element-wise accumulation; does NOT preserve unit-modulus. Distinguished from bundling: superposition is the un-normalized version used when count-magnitude information is needed in the substrate.

name: Bundling
description: Vector sum FOLLOWED BY NORMALIZATION (preserves unit-modulus / magnitude=1 constraint on output). Standard HRR/FHRR multi-item storage operation. Distinguished from superposition: bundling is the unit-modulus-preserving cleaner-input version.

name: Eigenvalue + eigenvector
description: For linear operator A: pair (lambda, v) with A v = lambda v, v != 0. Foundation for spectral theory + substrate Layer 2 observability (tw_edge_z, spectral_gap, mp_bulk_kl). Eigenvalues characterize operator action; eigenvectors are invariant directions.

name: Singular Value Decomposition (SVD)
description: Factorization A = U Sigma V^T for any matrix A in R^MxN. U + V orthonormal; Sigma diagonal singular values sigma_i >= 0. Foundation for low-rank approximation + PCA + spectral analysis + Marchenko-Pastur distribution analysis. SVD generalizes eigendecomposition to non-square matrices.

name: Marchenko-Pastur distribution
description: Limiting eigenvalue distribution of (1/N) X X^T for random matrix X in R^MxN with iid entries, as M,N -> inf with M/N -> lambda fixed. Bulk density supported on [lambda_minus, lambda_plus]; foundation for substrate codebook randomness baseline + Layer 2 mp_bulk_kl divergence measure.

name: Tracy-Widom distribution
description: Limiting distribution of largest eigenvalue (after rescaling) of random matrix ensembles (GUE, GOE, GSE). Foundation for substrate Layer 2 tw_edge_z measure: substrate atoms with tw_edge_z negative = structured codebook (atoms more clustered than random). Tail behavior asymmetric.

name: Voiculescu free probability
description: Non-commutative probability theory generalizing classical probability to operator-valued random variables. Foundation for substrate free-probability observability framework (kappa_4_rect free cumulant; spectral analysis of compositions). Free convolution replaces classical convolution for spectral measures.

name: Probability space
description: Triple (Omega, F, P) consisting of sample space + sigma-algebra + probability measure. Foundation for probability theory + Bayesian inference + substrate count-NB + HMM emissions. Kolmogorov axioms grounding.

name: Expectation + variance
description: First two moments of random variable: E[X] = integral X dP (linear functional); Var[X] = E[(X - E[X])^2]. Foundation for substrate uncertainty quantification (conformal + isotonic) + free-probability moments + statistical learning theory.

name: Kullback-Leibler divergence
description: Asymmetric measure D_KL(P || Q) = integral P log(P/Q) of how distribution Q differs from P. Non-negative; 0 iff P=Q. Foundation for substrate Layer 2 mp_bulk_kl measure + BOCPD changepoint detection + EM algorithm convergence + drift detection.

name: Limit of function
description: lim_{x -> a} f(x) = L: epsilon-delta definition foundation for calculus + continuity + analysis. Substrate-relevant: limits underlie convergence analysis of EM + gradient descent + Hopfield dynamics + iterative cleanup.

name: Derivative
description: f'(x) = lim_{h -> 0} (f(x+h) - f(x))/h: instantaneous rate of change. Foundation for gradient + Jacobian + optimization (gradient descent). Substrate gradient-descent training + backprop analogues.

name: Integral
description: Riemann/Lebesgue integral: limit of Riemann sums / Lebesgue measure-theoretic. Foundation for expectation + measure theory + convolution + Fourier transform. Substrate-relevant: integrate-then-discretize patterns in spectral measures.

name: Gradient
description: del f = (df/dx_1, ..., df/dx_n) vector of partial derivatives. Direction of steepest ascent. Foundation for gradient descent + backprop + substrate weight updates in discriminative perceptron + EM.

name: Group
description: Algebraic structure (G, *) with closure + associativity + identity + inverse. Abelian if commutative. Foundation for substrate HRR (cyclic group via convolution) + FHRR (complex unit circle group U(1)) + GHRR (matrix group GL(N)).

name: Ring + field
description: Ring: abelian group under + with associative multiplication distributing over +. Field: commutative ring with multiplicative inverses (except 0). Foundation for algebraic structure of substrate codebooks + linear algebra over R or C.

name: Metric space
description: Pair (X, d) with distance function d: X x X -> [0, inf) satisfying non-negativity + identity + symmetry + triangle inequality. Foundation for substrate cleanup retrieval (cosine + euclidean) + topology + analysis.

name: Measure space
description: Triple (X, F, mu) of set + sigma-algebra + measure. Foundation for integration + probability + Lebesgue theory + substrate-relevant continuous + discrete distribution unification.

name: Graph (V, E)
description: Pair (V, E) of vertex set + edge set. Foundation for graph algorithms + substrate relation structures + Chu-Liu-Edmonds tree decoding + Layer 3 archaeology relation analysis.

name: Tensor product representation (TPR)
description: Smolensky 1990 substrate-product binding via role x filler outer product. Bound representation R F^T preserves both role + filler explicitly. Supports multi-occurrence binding via explicit tensor positions. Distinguished from HRR/FHRR by preserving full tensor dimension (no folding).

metadata.substrate_role: non-unique role binding alternative to FHRR

name: Sparse distributed memory (SDM)
description: Kanerva 1988 + Frady-Sommer 2020 high-dimensional vector memory using sparse address spaces. Storage via address-content paired binding; retrieval via cleanup over distributed activation. Substrate-relevant: capacity scaling 0.15 N items per Hebbian rule; basis for substrate v3.2 SDM-multi-substrate wrapper.

name: AGS Hopfield capacity (0.138 N)
description: Amit-Gutfreund-Sompolinsky 1985 capacity theorem for Hopfield network with N neurons: M_max = 0.138 N patterns storable with vanishing error. Foundation for substrate capacity analysis + Hopfield-style cleanup capacity bounds.

name: Modern Hopfield network (Ramsauer 2020)
description: Ramsauer et al 2020 'Hopfield Networks Is All You Need' modern continuous Hopfield with exponential capacity. Energy function E = -lse(beta X^T xi) yields softmax-attention update rule. Connects classical associative memory to transformer attention.

name: Bienenstock-Cooper-Munro (BCM) learning rule
description: BCM 1982 plasticity rule with sliding threshold + biologically-grounded synaptic adaptation. dw/dt proportional to x phi(y, theta_m) where phi has zero crossing at moving threshold. Foundation for substrate biologically-grounded learning extensions.

name: Glauber dynamics
description: Stochastic dynamics for spin systems + statistical mechanics: single-spin flip Markov chain with detailed-balance + Boltzmann stationary distribution. Foundation for substrate stochastic-tunneling + escape-from-local-minima + Hopfield-style annealing.

name: Complementary Learning Systems (CLS)
description: McClelland-McNaughton-O'Reilly 1995 dual-memory architecture: hippocampus (fast pattern-separation episodic) + neocortex (slow generalization semantic). Replay + consolidation mechanism. Foundation for substrate dual-substrate wrapper + episodic-semantic separation.

name: Wright-Fisher process
description: Population genetics drift process: generation t+1 allele frequencies sampled binomially from generation t. Foundation for substrate evolutionary dynamics + drift-detection (Layer 8 substrate-self-evaluation).

name: Discrete Fourier transform (DFT)
description: Linear unitary transform F: C^N -> C^N. (F x)_k = sum_n x_n exp(-2 pi i k n / N). Foundation for FHRR circular convolution via convolution theorem F(x conv y) = F(x) F(y). Substrate FHRR algebra rides on DFT.

name: Bayesian Online Changepoint Detection (BOCPD)
description: Adams-MacKay 2007 BOCPD: online recursive Bayesian inference of changepoints in data stream. Maintains run-length posterior; hazard function controls changepoint rate. Foundation for substrate Layer 8 drift detection bounded by gate-frozen-at-cycle-0 architecture.

name: Matrix
description: Rectangular array of scalars from field F. Represents linear maps F^n -> F^m via matrix-vector product. Foundation for substrate codebook (matrix of stored atoms) + linear algebra operations + spectral analysis.

name: Dot product / inner product
description: Bilinear form <x, y> = sum x_i y_i (R) or sum x_i conj(y_i) (C). Foundation for cosine similarity + substrate cleanup + projection + orthogonality.

name: Orthogonality
description: Vectors x, y orthogonal iff <x, y> = 0. Foundation for orthonormal bases + Gram-Schmidt + FHRR random near-orthogonal codebooks + cleanup confusion bounds.

name: Hilbert space
description: Complete inner-product space. Foundation for quantum mechanics + functional analysis + substrate codebook as Hilbert space embedding (R^N or C^N with standard inner product).

name: Banach space
description: Complete normed vector space. Generalization of Hilbert: norm without inner product. Foundation for functional analysis + L^p spaces + substrate-relevant function approximation.

name: Tensor
description: Multilinear map V_1 x ... x V_k -> F or higher-order array. Foundation for TPR representation + outer products + higher-order substrate operations.

name: Kronecker product
description: Block-matrix tensor product A kron B in F^(MK x NL). Foundation for tensor product representations + quantum systems composition + multi-substrate algebra composition.

name: Chain rule
description: Derivative of composition (f o g)'(x) = f'(g(x)) g'(x). Foundation for backpropagation + substrate gradient training + automatic differentiation.

name: Taylor series
description: Local polynomial approximation f(x) ~ sum f^(k)(a) (x-a)^k / k!. Foundation for approximation theory + perturbation analysis + substrate sensitivity analysis.

name: Ordinary differential equation (ODE)
description: dy/dt = f(t, y) involving one independent variable. Foundation for dynamics + substrate-relevant Hopfield + neural ODE + Glauber-style continuous time analogues.

name: Partial differential equation (PDE)
description: Equation involving partial derivatives over multiple independent variables. Foundation for field theories + substrate-relevant Boltzmann equation + heat diffusion analogues.

name: Hessian matrix
description: Square matrix of second-order partial derivatives. Foundation for optimization (second-order methods) + substrate convexity analysis + Newton's method.

name: Gradient descent
description: Iterative optimization x_{k+1} = x_k - eta del f(x_k). Foundation for substrate discriminative perceptron training + EM + neural net training analogues.

name: Random variable
description: Measurable function X: (Omega, F, P) -> (R, Borel). Foundation for probability distributions + substrate count-NB + Bayesian inference + statistical inference.

name: Bayes rule
description: P(A|B) = P(B|A) P(A) / P(B). Foundation for Bayesian inference + substrate count-NB + posterior estimation + BMA.

name: Central limit theorem (CLT)
description: Sum of N iid random variables with finite variance converges in distribution to Normal as N -> infinity. Foundation for asymptotic statistics + substrate spectral large-N analysis.

name: Markov chain
description: Stochastic process with Markov property: P(X_{n+1} | X_n) = P(X_{n+1} | X_1, ..., X_n). Foundation for HMM + Viterbi + substrate temporal policy + MCMC.

name: Shannon entropy
description: H(X) = -sum p(x) log p(x). Measure of distribution uncertainty. Foundation for information theory + substrate uncertainty quantification + feature selection.

name: Cross entropy
description: H(P, Q) = -sum P log Q. Foundation for classification loss + substrate discriminative perceptron training + maximum-likelihood estimation.

name: Monoid
description: Algebraic structure with associative binary operation + identity (no inverse required). Foundation for substrate-relevant non-invertible compositions + free monoid in formal languages.

name: Group homomorphism
description: Structure-preserving map phi: G -> H with phi(ab) = phi(a) phi(b). Foundation for substrate algebra-preserving transformations + isomorphism analysis.

name: Lie algebra
description: Vector space with anti-commutative bilinear bracket [x, y] satisfying Jacobi identity. Foundation for continuous symmetries + substrate-relevant GHRR noncommutative bind underlying algebra.

name: Continuity
description: Function continuous at point a iff lim_{x -> a} f(x) = f(a). Foundation for analysis + substrate convergence analysis + Hopfield dynamics analysis.

name: Compactness
description: Topological property: every open cover has finite subcover. Foundation for extreme value theorem + finite-dimensional substrate codebook properties.

name: Binomial coefficient (n choose k)
description: C(n,k) = n! / (k! (n-k)!) ways to choose k items from n. Foundation for combinatorics + probability + substrate-relevant capacity analysis.

name: Symmetric group S_n
description: Group of all permutations of n elements. Foundation for substrate-relevant permutation-based binding + Recchia-Jones random-permutation alternatives + GHRR noncommutative structure.

name: Propositional logic
description: Formal system with propositional variables + boolean connectives (AND/OR/NOT/IMP/IFF). Foundation for logic + substrate reasoning routing + Bayesian-deductive reasoning.

name: Predicate (first-order) logic
description: Formal system with quantifiers (forall, exists) + relations over individuals. Foundation for mathematical logic + substrate reasoning routing + theorem proving.

name: Euclidean geometry
description: Geometry of flat n-dimensional space with standard metric. Foundation for substrate codebook geometric intuition + cosine distance + R^N embedding.

name: Riemannian manifold
description: Smooth manifold with positive-definite metric tensor at each point. Foundation for differential geometry + general relativity + substrate-relevant curved-space embeddings.

name: Binders (family)
description: Family of substrate primitives that bind role-filler pairs into composite representations: FHRR bind / HRR bind / TPR / GHRR matrix bind / Kronecker product. Distinguished from unbinders + mixers + transformers.

name: Unbinders (family)
description: Family of substrate primitives that recover filler from role + bound representation: FHRR unbind / HRR correlation / cleanup retrieval. Inverse family to binders.

name: Mixers (family)
description: Family of substrate primitives that combine multiple atoms into single representation without binding: superposition / bundling / normalized sum. Conjunction-like semantics.

name: Transformers (family)
description: Family of substrate primitives that transform representations: DFT / ZCA whitening / linear projection / permutation operators. Structure-preserving transformations.

name: Observers (family)
description: Family of substrate primitives that measure representation properties without modification: spectral_gap / tw_edge_z / mp_bulk_kl / kappa_4_free / shannon_entropy. Layer 2 spectral observability + uncertainty quantification.

name: Spectral gap
description: Difference between top eigenvalue and second eigenvalue of matrix. Substrate Layer 2 measure of leading-direction dominance. Used in substrate-codebook structure analysis.

name: Tracy-Widom edge z-score
description: Normalized z-score of top eigenvalue vs Tracy-Widom distribution: negative = below MP edge = structured codebook. Substrate Layer 2 spectral observability measure.

name: MP bulk KL divergence
description: KL divergence of eigenvalue empirical density from Marchenko-Pastur bulk. Substrate Layer 2 measure of codebook deviation from random; substrate algebra-HRR codebook 12x semantic-bge per Findings 11 v2.1.

name: Free 4th cumulant kappa_4_rect
description: Free-probability 4th cumulant kappa_4_rect = m_4 - (1 + lambda) m_2^2 where m_k are spectral moments + lambda = M/N aspect ratio. Substrate Layer 2 free-probability observability primitive.

name: Permutation-indexed binding (P^k)
description: k-th occurrence of same role bound using k-th permutation of role vector. Recchia-Jones 2015 random-permutation ~3x convolution paired-associate capacity. Substrate non-unique role binding alternative to FHRR bind.

name: Resonator network decoder
description: Iterative multi-factor cleanup decoder for compositional VSA bindings. Frady-Kent-Olshausen-Sommer 2020 + Langenegger 2023 Nature Nanotechnology. Decodes FULL set of bound factors not single argmax. Brain analogue: theta-gamma phase-locked iterative decoding.

name: GHRR noncommutative matrix bind
description: Generalized HRR matrix-based bind via noncommutative matrix multiplication. arXiv 2405.09689 2024. Multi-occurrence native: k-th instance at matrix position k. Substrate v4.0 lineage triangle component.

name: Conformal prediction
description: Distribution-free uncertainty quantification: produces prediction sets with calibrated coverage guarantees. Substrate ECE 0.044 with isotonic + conformal calibration per north-star UQ memory.

name: Isotonic regression
description: Non-parametric monotonic regression: fits monotonic step function minimizing squared error. Substrate calibration primitive + Platt scaling alternative.

name: Eisner projective dependency parsing
description: O(N^3) bottom-up dynamic programming for projective dependency parse decoding. Substrate-CRF Tier-3 decoder primitive paired with Chu-Liu-Edmonds (non-projective) + Viterbi (chain).

name: Structured perceptron (Collins)
description: Collins 2002 discriminative max-margin classifier with structured-output decoding (assignment-constraint enforcement). Learns weights via mistake-driven structured-perceptron update over joint feature representation. NOT probabilistic; max-margin formulation in structured output space.

name: Expectation-Maximization (EM)
description: Dempster-Laird-Rubin 1977 iterative MLE for latent-variable models. E-step computes posterior over latents; M-step maximizes complete-data log-likelihood. Substrate weak-label training mechanism.

name: Viterbi decoder
description: O(N K^2) dynamic programming algorithm for max-product MAP decoding in HMM / chain CRF. Substrate-classical sequence decoder used in PP-364 POS Tier-A + PP-369 slot-filling Tier-B.

name: Forward algorithm
description: O(N K^2) dynamic programming for marginal posterior alpha_t(k) = P(o_1..o_t, x_t=k). Substrate companion to Viterbi for sum-product semiring.

name: Backward algorithm
description: O(N K^2) dynamic programming for backward probability beta_t(k) = P(o_{t+1}..o_N | x_t=k). Substrate companion to forward for full posteriors + EM training.

name: Hungarian algorithm
description: Kuhn-Munkres O(N^3) algorithm for optimal bipartite matching with cost matrix. Substrate role-assigner primitive for discriminative-weighted matching.

name: Chu-Liu-Edmonds algorithm
description: Edmonds 1967 + Chu-Liu 1965 O(N^2) algorithm for maximum-spanning-arborescence (directed MST) decoding. Substrate non-projective dependency parse decoder.

name: Principal Component Analysis (PCA)
description: Linear orthogonal projection maximizing variance along top eigenvectors of covariance matrix. Substrate dimensionality analysis + decorrelation.

name: Gram-Schmidt orthogonalization
description: Iterative algorithm producing orthonormal basis from linearly independent set. Foundation for QR decomposition + substrate codebook orthogonalization.

name: Johnson-Lindenstrauss lemma
description: Random projection from R^N to R^k for k = O(log N / eps^2) approximately preserves pairwise distances within (1 +/- eps). Foundation for substrate dimensionality reduction + FHRR random near-orthogonal capacity analysis.

name: Cascade HMM pipeline (macro)
description: Composite algorithm: HMM emission + transition + Viterbi + context-window features stacked. Substrate-classical NL primitive applied to POS / slot-filling / NER. Macro of T3 primitives.

name: Discriminative perceptron pipeline (macro)
description: Composite algorithm: discriminative perceptron + Tier-2 schema bundles + Hungarian/role-binding + count-NB features. Universal lever per Findings 12 substrate solution-history 92pct current-best.

name: Matrix inverse
description: Inverse A^-1 of square matrix A satisfying A A^-1 = I. Foundation for solving linear systems + matrix factorization + substrate-relevant covariance inversion (ZCA whitening).

name: Matrix norms
description: Norm functions on matrices: Frobenius / operator / nuclear / spectral. Foundation for matrix sensitivity + low-rank approximation + substrate codebook stability.

name: Rank-nullity theorem
description: For linear map T: V -> W: dim(V) = rank(T) + nullity(T). Foundation for substrate codebook capacity + dimension analysis.

name: Null space / kernel
description: Kernel ker(T) = {v: T v = 0} of linear map T. Foundation for solving homogeneous systems + substrate symmetry analysis.

name: Jacobian matrix
description: Matrix of first partial derivatives J_ij = df_i/dx_j of vector-valued function f: R^N -> R^M. Foundation for nonlinear analysis + substrate backprop chain rule generalization.

name: Lagrange multiplier
description: Variable lambda introduced in constrained optimization: minimize f(x) subject to g(x)=0 via L = f - lambda g. Foundation for constrained learning + KKT conditions.

name: Convex function
description: Function f satisfying f(t x + (1-t) y) <= t f(x) + (1-t) f(y) for t in [0,1]. Foundation for convex optimization + substrate-relevant loss function design.

name: KKT conditions
description: Karush-Kuhn-Tucker first-order optimality conditions for constrained nonlinear optimization (stationarity + primal feasibility + dual feasibility + complementary slackness). Foundation for constrained learning + SVM.

name: Lagrangian duality
description: Primal-dual relationship: dual function g(lambda) <= primal optimal. Strong duality for convex with Slater. Foundation for SVM + substrate-relevant primal-dual analysis.

name: Newton's method
description: Iterative root-finding / optimization x_{k+1} = x_k - H^-1 g (or x_k - f/f'). Quadratic convergence near optimum. Foundation for second-order optimization + substrate-relevant fast convergence cells.

name: Cauchy sequence
description: Sequence {x_n} where for all eps > 0 exists N such that |x_m - x_n| < eps for m,n > N. Foundation for completeness + convergence in metric spaces + substrate-relevant fixed-point analysis.

name: Uniform convergence
description: Function sequence f_n -> f uniformly iff sup_x |f_n(x) - f(x)| -> 0. Foundation for analysis + substrate-relevant function approximation.

name: Lebesgue integration
description: Measure-theoretic integration generalizing Riemann. Foundation for probability theory + substrate-relevant integration over arbitrary measures.

name: L^p space
description: Banach space of measurable functions with finite p-norm integral. Foundation for functional analysis + substrate-relevant function-space embeddings.

name: Borel set
description: Set generated from open sets by countable union/intersection/complement. Foundation for measure theory + substrate-relevant random variable measurability.

name: Characteristic function (probability)
description: phi_X(t) = E[exp(itX)] Fourier transform of probability distribution. Foundation for asymptotic statistics + CLT proof + substrate-relevant distribution comparison.

name: Concentration inequality
description: Bounds on probability that random variable deviates from its mean (Markov / Chebyshev / Chernoff / Hoeffding / McDiarmid). Foundation for learning theory + substrate-relevant generalization bounds.

name: Mutual information
description: I(X; Y) = sum p(x,y) log(p(x,y)/(p(x)p(y))) = H(X) - H(X|Y). Measure of dependence between random variables. Foundation for substrate feature selection + uncertainty quantification.

name: Fisher information
description: I_F(theta) = E[(d log p_theta / d theta)^2] amount of information data carries about parameter. Foundation for Cramer-Rao bound + substrate-relevant gradient sensitivity analysis.

name: Renyi divergence
description: Parametric generalization of KL divergence: D_alpha(P || Q). Foundation for differential privacy + substrate-relevant divergence family analysis.

name: Module over ring
description: Generalization of vector space where scalars come from ring instead of field. Foundation for algebraic topology + substrate-relevant non-field algebra.

name: Ideal (ring theory)
description: Subset I of ring R closed under addition + absorbs multiplication by ring elements. Foundation for ring theory + substrate-relevant algebraic structure.

name: Quotient group
description: Group G / N formed by cosets of normal subgroup N. Foundation for group theory + substrate-relevant equivalence classes.

name: Spectral theorem
description: Self-adjoint operators on Hilbert space decompose into orthogonal projections weighted by eigenvalues. Foundation for substrate Layer 2 spectral observability + PCA + SVD.

name: Riesz representation theorem
description: Continuous linear functional on Hilbert space H is given by inner product with unique element of H. Foundation for functional analysis + substrate-relevant dual-space identification.

name: Banach fixed-point theorem
description: Contraction mapping on complete metric space has unique fixed point. Foundation for substrate-relevant iterative methods convergence (cleanup iteration / Hopfield dynamics).

name: Dirac delta function
description: Generalized function delta(x) with integral 1 and supp = {0}. Foundation for substrate-relevant point-mass representations + impulse response.

name: Convolution (general)
description: Integral/sum (f * g)(t) = integral f(tau) g(t-tau) dtau. Foundation for FHRR bind via circular convolution + signal processing + substrate-relevant filter analysis.

name: Topological space
description: Set X with collection of open subsets (topology) satisfying axioms. Foundation for analysis + substrate-relevant continuity + connectedness.

name: Category
description: Collection of objects + morphisms with composition + identity. Foundation for category theory + substrate-relevant DisCoCat (substrate v4.0 lineage) + abstract algebra unification.

name: Attention mechanism
description: Softmax-weighted combination of values based on query-key similarity: attn(Q,K,V) = softmax(QK^T / sqrt(d)) V. Foundation for modern Hopfield Ramsauer connection + transformer architectures.

name: Positional encoding (sinusoidal)
description: Encoding of position via sinusoids: PE(pos, 2i) = sin(pos / 10000^(2i/d)). Foundation for transformer position-awareness + substrate-relevant order encoding analogues.

name: Dropout regularization
description: Stochastic regularization: zero out random subset of activations during training. Foundation for substrate-relevant noise-based regularization analogues.

name: Batch normalization
description: Normalization layer rescaling activations to zero mean + unit variance per batch. Foundation for stable training + substrate-relevant pre-conditioning.

name: Layer normalization
description: Normalization across features within layer (per-sample). Foundation for transformer training stability + substrate-relevant per-atom normalization.

name: Adam optimizer
description: Adaptive moment estimation: per-parameter learning rate via first + second moment estimates. Foundation for modern neural net training + substrate-relevant gradient-based learning.

name: Stochastic gradient descent (SGD)
description: Per-mini-batch gradient updates: x_{k+1} = x_k - eta nabla L(batch_k). Foundation for modern ML + substrate-relevant online learning.

name: Contrastive learning (InfoNCE)
description: Self-supervised learning via positive/negative pair discrimination: maximize sim(x, x+) vs sim(x, x-). Foundation for representation learning + substrate-relevant analogues.

name: Softmax function
description: softmax(x_i) = exp(x_i) / sum exp(x_j). Foundation for classification probability outputs + attention mechanism + substrate-relevant probability normalization.

name: Mean squared error (MSE)
description: Loss L = (1/N) sum (y_i - y_hat_i)^2. Foundation for regression + substrate-relevant continuous-target learning.

name: K-means clustering
description: Lloyd's algorithm: iterative assignment + center update minimizing within-cluster variance. Foundation for unsupervised clustering + substrate-relevant prototype generation.

name: Hierarchical clustering
description: Agglomerative / divisive clustering producing dendrogram. Foundation for clustering + substrate-relevant prototype hierarchy.

name: Word2vec embedding
description: Distributional word embedding via skip-gram or CBOW. Foundation for distributional semantics + substrate-relevant comparison baseline.

name: GloVe embedding
description: Global vectors via co-occurrence matrix factorization. Foundation for distributional semantics + substrate-relevant semantic-vec comparison.

name: Byte-pair encoding (BPE)
description: Subword tokenization via iterative merging of frequent byte pairs. Foundation for modern LLM tokenization + substrate-relevant token-vocabulary primitive.

name: SentencePiece tokenizer
description: Language-agnostic subword tokenization via unigram model or BPE. Used in most modern LLMs.

name: LSTM cell
description: Long short-term memory recurrent cell with input/forget/output gates + cell state. Foundation for RNN sequence modeling + substrate-relevant gated recurrence.

name: Transformer block
description: Self-attention + feed-forward + residual + layer norm. Foundation for transformer architectures + substrate-relevant comparison baseline.

name: Residual / skip connection
description: Identity shortcut: y = F(x) + x. Foundation for deep residual networks + substrate-relevant gradient flow.

name: Policy gradient
description: RL policy update via gradient of expected reward: nabla J = E[nabla log pi * Q]. Foundation for REINFORCE + Actor-Critic + substrate-relevant reward-driven learning.

name: Q-learning
description: Off-policy temporal-difference RL: Q(s,a) <- Q(s,a) + alpha (r + gamma max Q(s',a') - Q(s,a)). Foundation for RL + substrate-relevant value learning.

name: Markov decision process (MDP)
description: Mathematical framework for sequential decision making: (S, A, P, R, gamma). Foundation for RL + substrate-relevant sequential decision modeling.

name: Bellman equation
description: V(s) = max_a [r(s,a) + gamma E[V(s')]] dynamic programming recursion. Foundation for optimal control + RL + substrate-relevant value iteration.

name: Cosine similarity
description: sim(u, v) = u . v / (|u| |v|). Foundation for vector similarity + substrate cleanup retrieval + semantic-vec comparison.

name: Euclidean distance
description: d(u, v) = sqrt(sum (u_i - v_i)^2). Foundation for metric retrieval + substrate-relevant distance-based cleanup.

name: Locality-sensitive hashing (LSH)
description: Hashing scheme where similar inputs likely hash to same bucket. Foundation for approximate nearest neighbor + substrate-relevant fast retrieval.

name: Random projection
description: Linear projection to lower dimension via random matrix. Foundation for dimensionality reduction + substrate-relevant codebook compression.

name: Feature hashing (hashing trick)
description: Hash-based feature encoding for high-cardinality categorical features. Foundation for substrate-relevant feature compression + count-based ML.

name: Iterative proportional fitting (IPF)
description: Iterative scaling algorithm matching marginal constraints. Foundation for contingency table fitting + substrate-relevant constrained probability.

name: Lyapunov stability theory
description: Lyapunov stability theory for dynamical systems convergence + asymptotic stability + fixed-point attractor analysis. Stability via Lyapunov function: V > 0 + V_dot < 0 implies asymptotic convergence to equilibrium. Foundation for control theory + substrate-relevant Hopfield cleanup + fixed-point attractor convergence analysis + dynamical stability + nonlinear systems stability + equilibrium analysis. Brain analogue: substrate cleanup attractor basins + Hopfield energy minimization + neural dynamics convergence.

name: State-space representation
description: Linear time-invariant system representation: x_dot = A x + B u + y = C x + D u. Foundation for control theory + substrate-relevant dynamical state encoding.

name: Kalman filter
description: Optimal Bayesian state estimation for linear-Gaussian dynamical systems via recursive predict + update steps. Foundation for state estimation + substrate-relevant temporal-policy analogues.

name: PID control + feedback
description: Proportional-integral-derivative control loop: u = K_p e + K_i integral e + K_d de/dt. Foundation for control engineering + substrate-relevant feedback-loop analogues.

name: Linear quadratic regulator (LQR)
description: Optimal control for linear systems with quadratic cost via Riccati equation. Foundation for optimal control + substrate-relevant cost-minimization framework.

name: Dynamic programming (Bellman)
description: Optimization technique decomposing problems into recursive subproblems via Bellman equation. Foundation for sequential optimization + substrate-relevant Viterbi + Forward DP analogues.

name: Runge-Kutta methods (numerical ODE)
description: Fourth-order accurate numerical integration for ODE: RK4 update with weighted slope averages. Foundation for ODE solving + substrate-relevant dynamical-system simulation.

name: Conjugate gradient method
description: Iterative solver for symmetric positive-definite linear systems Ax=b. Foundation for numerical linear algebra + substrate-relevant fast linear solvers.

name: Levenberg-Marquardt algorithm
description: Damped least-squares method for nonlinear curve fitting: interpolates between Gauss-Newton + gradient descent. Foundation for nonlinear regression.

name: L-BFGS quasi-Newton
description: Limited-memory BFGS approximation to Newton's method. Foundation for medium-scale optimization + substrate-relevant fast convergence cells.

name: Sparse matrix techniques
description: Efficient storage + operations for matrices with mostly-zero entries: CSR + COO + sparse SVD. Foundation for substrate-relevant large-scale linear algebra.

name: Fast Fourier transform (FFT)
description: O(N log N) implementation of DFT via Cooley-Tukey divide-and-conquer. Foundation for signal processing + substrate FHRR circular convolution via convolution theorem.

name: Wavelet transform
description: Multi-resolution time-frequency analysis via wavelet basis. Foundation for signal processing + substrate-relevant multi-scale analysis.

name: Digital filter design (FIR/IIR)
description: Finite + infinite impulse response filters for signal processing. Foundation for signal filtering + substrate-relevant smoothing.

name: Spectral density estimation (Welch / periodogram)
description: Power spectral density via FFT-based methods. Foundation for signal analysis + substrate-relevant frequency-domain observability.

name: Cross-validation (k-fold)
description: Model evaluation via k-fold partitioning + average performance. Foundation for substrate empirical validation per method-overclaim rule.

name: Bootstrap resampling
description: Non-parametric statistical inference via resampling with replacement. Foundation for empirical confidence intervals per slot-filling multi-seed bootstrap.

name: Permutation test
description: Non-parametric hypothesis test via permuting labels + comparing test statistic to null distribution. Foundation for substrate empirical significance testing.

name: Bayes factor
description: Ratio of marginal likelihoods for Bayesian model comparison: BF_01 = p(D|M_0)/p(D|M_1). Foundation for Bayesian hypothesis testing.

name: Markov chain Monte Carlo (MCMC)
description: Sampling from probability distributions via Markov chain: Metropolis-Hastings + Gibbs + HMC. Foundation for Bayesian inference + substrate-relevant probabilistic computation.

name: Variational inference (VI)
description: Approximate Bayesian inference via optimization of evidence lower bound (ELBO). Foundation for scalable Bayesian inference + VAE.

name: Gaussian process (GP)
description: Distribution over functions defined by mean + covariance kernel. Foundation for Bayesian regression + Bayesian optimization.

name: Kernel methods (kernel trick)
description: Implicit feature mapping via kernel function K(x,y) = <phi(x), phi(y)>. Foundation for SVM + kernel ridge regression + substrate-relevant similarity analogues.

name: Random Fourier features
description: Approximation of kernel via random feature map + linear method. Foundation for scalable kernel methods + substrate-relevant random-projection analogues.

name: Normal forms (Chomsky + Greibach)
description: Canonical grammar forms for context-free grammars: Chomsky normal form + Greibach normal form. Foundation for parsing + substrate-relevant grammar manipulation.

name: CYK parser (Cocke-Younger-Kasami)
description: O(n^3) dynamic programming parser for context-free grammars in CNF. Foundation for parsing + substrate-relevant DP parsing.

name: Earley parser
description: O(n^3) parser handling arbitrary context-free grammars without CNF requirement. Foundation for general parsing.

name: Finite-state transducer (FST)
description: Finite automaton with input + output tapes. Foundation for morphology + phonology + substrate-relevant transduction.

name: Edit distance (Levenshtein)
description: Minimum number of insertions + deletions + substitutions to transform string A to B. Foundation for sequence alignment + spelling correction.

name: Needleman-Wunsch alignment
description: Global sequence alignment via dynamic programming for biological sequences. Foundation for bioinformatics + substrate-relevant sequence comparison.

name: Lebesgue measure
description: Countably-additive set function generalizing length/area/volume; foundation for modern integration + probability. Substrate-relevant for probabilistic atom weight assignment + integration over high-dimensional concept space.

name: Metric topology
description: Topology induced by distance function via open balls; standard for finite-dimensional analysis. Substrate-relevant: cosine distance defines metric on unit hypersphere where atoms live.

name: Random walks on graphs
description: Stochastic process where walker steps between graph nodes via edge transitions; stationary distribution + mixing time + hitting time + cover time + commute distance. Substrate-relevant: substrate retrieval as random walk on concept_links graph; Tolman cognitive map analogue.

name: Recursion
description: Self-referential computation: f(n) defined in terms of f(n-1) or smaller subproblems. Requires a base case for termination. Foundation for induction, fixed-point iteration, and dynamic programming. Examples: factorial, fibonacci, recursive tree traversal, recursive proof unfolding.

name: Optimal substructure (Bellman principle of optimality)
description: Optimal solution decomposes into optimal solutions of subproblems (Bellman 1957). Foundational property required for dynamic programming correctness. Examples: Dijkstra shortest path, knapsack DP, Viterbi decoding, RL value iteration.

name: Discrete Fourier Transform (DFT)
description: X_k = sum_{n=0}^{N-1} x_n exp(-2*pi*i*k*n/N); inverse x_n = (1/N) sum X_k exp(+2*pi*i*k*n/N). Linear, Parseval norm-preserving; convolution in time domain becomes pointwise multiplication in frequency domain. Foundation for FHRR substrate, signal processing, and frequency-domain analysis.
